newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 13.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from the noon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- M1 sources said that the presidents of Slovakia, Hungary, Bulgaria, Romania and the Czech Republic were invited to participate in the conference on good neighbourly relations scheduled for the beginning of September in Vilnius.
The presidents of Finland, Poland, Estonia, Latvia, Ukraine, Belarus and Russia's prime minister will participate in the conference.
- The prosecutor's office is expected to apply to parliament to strip the immunity of MP Audrius Butkevickius who is alleged to have taken a $15,000.
Buthevichius denied the accusations and said he was borrowing the money.
